reason: The hypothesis combines the room-temperature tribocatalytic self-lubrication mechanism of 2D HEA nanoflakes (P3, P5) with the high-temperature lubricant effectiveness demonstrated for Mg(ReO4)2 (P9) to propose a single coating effective across a wide temperature range, a synthesis neither passage suggests. It also transfers the 2D HEA coating from steel substrates to bulk HEA components and proposes a specific falsification test with controlled ethanol vapor and multi-temperature analysis, which is not described in the cited passages.
copied_elements: spray-coating 2D HEA nanoflakes as solid lubricant
catalytic dissociation of ethanol to amorphous carbon tribofilm
reduction in COF and wear rate
broad temperature range effectiveness from Mg(ReO4)2 additive study
